notes.title: Update v1.6.1
notes.content:
Physical Blood

We added physics to the blood; when you get hit by a zombie or shoot one, some blood particles are emitted, falling to the ground and disappearing after a few seconds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/e5656f878b8a127abc661cc832eeb52f4a4d618a.gif

Particle Limiter

We implemented a system to limit the amount of particles, ensuring that they don't impact the game's performance, especially when using high-rate-of-fire weapons.

Adjustments to Shooting Effect

The shooting effects have been readjusted!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/e7ef1fc22395030283c17760b4df3bc2953a57ba.png

Modifications:
➣ Player now also emits blood.

Issues Fixed:
➣ When dying and completing a mission, the game didn't display the death screen;
➣ Endless mode missions were not working.

notes.title: Update v1.6
notes.content:
Cloud Save

Now, the game has the option to save your progress in the cloud, meaning you can play your game on multiple machines with cloud synchronization. And if you uninstall the game, your save will still be in the cloud.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/40fdb2fff2ffa7818dd02185faad0c95e53b0e74.png

Blood

When you shoot a zombie, it sprays some blood particles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/eab2ec73c3f5d03eda5c71b0f5481e5e16d86045.png

Day Cycle

In the game lobby, time passes, and when it gets dark, the streetlights come on.

➣ Can't ask the NPC to stop following you in the tutorial anymore;
➣ Tutorial texts now last longer;
➣ Infinite mode is now limited to 100 zombies on the map.

Fixed Issues:
➣ The continue option was available the first time the game was opened;
➣ Responsiveness of the tutorial interface.

Mobile Version Suspension!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/c5e008e40a98402846ad36128d259dea0e908cf9.png

I'd like to report a problem we've recently encountered with Google Play.

Despite recognizing the platform's efficiency, I've been confronted with a contractor who ended up having their activities banned by the Google Developer Console. Consequently, my account was also affected, resulting in the deletion of all the games I had published, loss of access to the platform, and a permanent ban on creating a new developer account.

The lack of transparency about the reasons behind this decision makes dealing with the situation even more difficult. Despite contesting the measure, I received the response that it wouldn't be possible to reverse the decision and that they couldn't share the specific reasons for this conclusion.

Currently, I'm at an impasse, especially since I was close to launching the mobile version of Pew Pew Squad on the Play Store. We were in the process of fixing some compatibility issues, but the multiplayer and all features were working correctly.

At the moment, we have suspended the development of the mobile version of Pew Pew Squad until we resolve this issue with Google Play. We are exploring all available options, including seeking legal assistance if necessary.

notes.title: Update v1.5
notes.content:
Multiplayer

Now you'll be able to play freely with your friends without needing to host on your machine. The clothes, weapons, and money from multiplayer are the same as the normal game, so you won't lose your progress!

[previewyoutube=mClcUTdQ7qs;full][/previewyoutube]

Features:

 Now you can play matches with 2 to 12 players, including friendly fire option.
 Players have the freedom to create private or public matches.
 After elimination, players enter spectator mode.
 Zombie drops are not shared between players, ensuring everyone receives their own loot.

Game Servers:

 Brazil
 United States
 Europe

  Colyseus Framework  
We use the Colyseus Framework, a free and open-source tool, perfect for creating robust, reliable, and scalable authoritative servers. With support for JavaScript/TypeScript, this framework has allowed us to efficiently and scalably implement multiplayer, ensuring a smooth, cheat-free gaming experience. Additionally, it is compatible with various platforms, including Unity, Cocos, Haxe 4, and Construct 3.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/f6bc5e92f17a568ed1361224e786ee06d29ce4fa.png

notes.title: Update v1.3
notes.content:
Minimap
Now, with the minimap, you can have a broader view around you, but it remains limited to a short distance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/ac3c5c57831a55c3ff7ab0e79eb3179130ed67f9.png

New Weapons HUD
In the new HUD, you can see the previous and next weapons, making it easier to switch weapons and control ammunition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/f5b5e2b3187ead076c1050f7b23377935c543c6e.png

Running Effect
When you run, there will be some feedback particles from your feet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/b9f0cd7ed215615e92f8842a82007d45b7257cef.png

New Ammunition
The ammunition system has been changed. Instead of universal ammunition for the equipped weapon, it has been divided into three types: light ammo (green box), medium ammo (purple box), and heavy ammo (yellow box).

 Light ammo for weak weapons, like pistols and semi-automatics.
 Medium ammo for regular machine guns.
 Heavy ammo for explosive weapons and heavy machine guns.

Light ammo is available on easier difficulties. From the Regular difficulty onwards, medium and heavy ammo replace it (with a 10% chance of heavy ammo appearing).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44715298/5320831700799cb1a301c12fcc91518cc516ad6a.png

Added features:
➣ Backpack symbol next to the weapon when purchasing;
➣ Victory, defeat, zombie attack, and store sounds;
➣ New zombie attack animation.

Modifications:
➣ The player runs 20% faster;
➣ Zombie attacks end more quickly.

Fixed issues:
➣ Bridge map locked;
➣ Zombie attack counted before hitting;
➣ Part of the city glitched the camera.

notes.title: Official launch of Pew Pew Squad!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/vgGCCP9.png
 Introducing Pew Pew Squad 
Check out Pew Pew Squad! The epic remaster of Pow Pow Pew Pew Simulator! Explore a zombie-filled universe in a top-down 2.5D view, with a high-quality low-poly aesthetic.

Face increasingly challenging waves of the undead, upgrade your weapons, and strengthen your arsenal. In Pew Pew Squad, survival is the key to success. Get ready for an intense and immersive gaming experience where strategy and action come together.

 Thanks: 
The countless feedback and overwhelming community support played a crucial role in significantly strengthening the project. Currently, the focus is on creating new updates and establishing an active presence in the community we're building.

I'd like to thank everyone who contributed to the game's development, for the support and all the ideas you've sent me. This is just the beginning, and I can't wait to see the community grow even more!
